description: Check status, ETA and tracking for a UFP order. Pass a checkout id (co_…, from checkout_cart) in order_id to get every order of that cart checkout at once — each part is its own order with its own shop, status and tracking. The answer carries status_url: a link the user can open or pass on to follow the order with no sign-in; it shows progress only (no price, no address, nothing that can change the order).

order_id.description: The order (ord_…), or a cart checkout (co_…) to read all of its orders

name: get_order_status
title: Get order status
